review_questions: Is MultiDomainSchedulerV1 the only global scheduling and time authority?
Are directed links, clocks, queues, credits, resources and duplex groups explicit and hash-bound?
Are exact rational CDC and synthetic alignment semantics complete and non-hardware claims explicit?
Is capacity enforced separately per private VRAM and once for shared UMA aliases?
Are remote token assignments exactly dispatch-compute-return-combine while local assignments reject phantom traffic?
Are whole-expert replicate/move visibility, destination reservation and live pins fail closed?
Are queue, credit, byte, routing and assignment conservation enforced?
Does UMA forbid phantom P2P and enforce immutable objects plus monotonic release/read versions?
Do canonical digests count and tag every variable collection and optional field?
Does live checkpoint bind all topology/program/state and accept only exact reachable-prefix restore?
Does admission prevalidate every fallible transition and remain byte-identical after a rejected admission?
Are Phase5 CompiledAction IDs recomputed from their semantic preimages and exact plan digest before membership is accepted?
Are ExpertKey and immutable content identity bound to the actual resident or transferred object?
Does every route require request_id, token_index, layer_index and priority 100, bind selected experts to the route layer, and preserve the same identity across dispatch/compute/return/combine?
Are empty request_id, UINT64_MAX token_index and UINT32_MAX layer_index rejected as the frozen missing-value sentinels?
Are duplicate in-flight destination reservations and same-object UMA overlaps prevented without double-reserving capacity?
Are ACK_OR_CREDIT events distinct at frozen priority 40 and crossing operations forbidden from reusing priority 50?
Are inclusive alignment ranges enforced at every start, visibility, acknowledge, next-time and checkpoint boundary?
Does the fresh R4 run bind the exact source root and pass Release plus native sanitizer regressions?
Does the candidate exact-set include every nested ledger while excluding only its active ledger and current review results?
Are measured hardware, Mixtral, GPU, calibration, DSE and production-scale claims absent?
